Its P5+ framework is hard to reduce, so it should resist reaction with Li6PS5Cl and remain stable near 4.0 V vs Li, keeping the interfacial penalty low. This is a different polymorph of the Li3PO4 composition proposed earlier, and its ID is listed as available.
